en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a train station with platforms, benches, and covered waiting areas. There are railway tracks in the foreground, and the station buildings with traditional European architecture are visible in the background. Lamp posts and signage can be seen, as well as nearby houses and a church-like building in the distance. Text is printed at the bottom of the postcard.
